claims.claim: Microkernel and monolithic-kernel designs make different tradeoffs in isolation boundaries, communication and subsystem placement.

claims.notes: Performance and reliability depend on concrete implementations, not labels alone.

claims.claim: Linux maintains a stable userspace ABI while internal kernel interfaces may evolve between releases.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: In-kernel APIs and userspace ABI are different compatibility contracts.

claims.claim: Linux kernel development emphasizes upstream review and community-maintained integration.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Project workflows and subsystem maintainer requirements vary.

claims.claim: seL4 形式化证明覆盖特定内核实现、抽象规范、配置与假设；不能外推为所有用户态服务、驱动、硬件与部署配置都被证明。
claims.notes: 性能数字必须附平台、编译器、消息大小与测量方法。

claims.claim: Linux 用户空间 ABI 稳定原则不意味着所有内核内部接口（尤其模块内部 API）稳定；内核模块通常需针对目标内核重新构建与测试。
claims.notes: 外部模块不应假定跨版本稳定 ABI。
